# ROPA-0001: Gradebook sync

| Status | Version | Record type | Business area | Business owner | System owner | Next review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Draft | 0.1 | Processor (Provisional) | Product | TBC | Integrations team | 2027-03-01 |

Nightly sync of rosters and grades from district LMSs into the reading app, with reading-level scores written back. Covers K-12 students and teachers, processed on the districts' behalf.

**Open items:** 3 Art. 30 elements TBC · 0 questions block launch · 3 block approval · 0 launch-blocking actions open · Lawful bases Open

**Launch:** no blockers recorded. The privacy lead decides whether anything open should block launch.

**Still TBC:** Art. 30(1)(a)/(2)(a): company name and contact; Art. 30(1)(e)/(2)(c): transfers; Art. 30(1)(g)/(2)(d): security measures.

**Recommended follow-ons:**

- `dpia`: Children's data, a possible disability flag, and a scoring model
- `vendor-review`: Error monitoring vendor captures student payloads
- `ai-intake`: The recommendation model scores students
- `tia`: AWS stores the data in the United States
